description: Storm date finder: Candidate storm dates for a point over up to 365 days, ranking each day by NEXRAD radar hail signatures (NOAA SWDI nx3hail) combined with NWS ground reports (hail size, wind gusts, tornadoes) from the IEM LSR archive. Sources: NOAA NCEI SWDI, NWS LSR via IEM. Heuristic ranking, not a date-of-loss determination. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: summary{candidate_dates, top_date, max_hail_in, max_wind_mph}, candidates[{date, radar{detections, max_size_in}, ground{hail_reports, max_hail_in, max_wind_mph, tornado_reports}, score}].
name: x420_storm_date-finder
